title: PromotionUniV2_Eth pool() Legs A/B swap + addLiquidity at live pool ratio relies solely on pooler-supplied min-out floors with no on-chain price reference (MEV sandwich)
siblingNote: SAME root-cause CLASS as L-06 (342075df…, `onchain-priceless-lp-add-mev`) but a DISTINCT contract and distinct legs, so it carries its own fingerprint (e64f73d6…) and its own label. Split rationale (deduplicator + severity-auditor concurrence): L-06's ledger `contract` field is `src/dispatchers/BalancerPoolerV2.sol` (single-sided sUSDS LP-add), and `contract` is part of the fingerprint tuple. Folding the PromotionUniV2_Eth two-leg UniV2 swap+add instance into L-06 risked a SILENT CROSS-CONTRACT CLOSURE: if BalancerPoolerV2's L-06 is later marked `fixed`, the PromotionUniV2_Eth MEV instance would close with it even though its code was never touched. Tracking it as its own label (L-15) gives independent, per-contract fix tracking. Cross-reference L-06 as the sibling class; do NOT re-fold.
description: PromotionUniV2_Eth.pool() executes on-chain swaps (Leg A USDC->USDS(PSM)->sUSDS->phUSD via Balancer V3; Leg B USDC->ETH->promotion via UniV2) and then an addLiquidity into the phUSD/promotion pair at the pool's LIVE ratio. Slippage is protected ONLY by pooler-supplied minimum-out floors (minPhusdOut, minEthOut, minPromoOut, minWbtcOut) plus the post-add minLP floor -- all five floors are present and enforced -- with NO on-chain price reference (no spot/TWAP sanity bound). The thin, two-hop USDC->ETH->promotion Leg B is the shallowest surface: if the keeper sets its floors loosely relative to live depth, a searcher can sandwich the swap and/or the subsequent live-ratio LP add.
impact: Bounded and Low. Value at risk is protocol-owned liquidity (POL) only -- no user funds route through pool(); the entry is keeper-gated (onlyAuthorizedPooler) so there is no unprivileged zero-floor trigger. Loss is capped by the five present min-out floors + minLP, which the keeper controls. There is no theft of third-party funds and no availability/DoS impact. Same severity ceiling as the sibling L-06 class: Low, keeper-floor-bounded, POL-only.
attackPath: Keeper (onlyAuthorizedPooler) calls pool() with min-out floors set loosely relative to live depth on the thin ETH->promotion Leg B.
A searcher observes the pending pool() and sandwiches the USDC->ETH->promotion swap and/or the live-ratio addLiquidity.
The extractable amount is bounded by the gap between the pooler-supplied floors and true execution price; only protocol-owned liquidity is affected.
recommendation: Keep the pooler min-out floors (especially Leg B's) tuned to live per-leg depth; an on-chain spot/TWAP sanity bound on the swap and the LP-add ratio would remove the sole reliance on the off-chain floor. Not required to hold the finding at Low. Track and fix this instance per-contract, independently of the sibling BalancerPoolerV2 instance (L-06) -- do not assume a fix to one covers the other.
